info.name: Breaks & Bass
info.description: Breakbeat, drum and bass, UK garage and dubstep, with a 2-step song and a wobble bass song.

songs.name: Dubstep
songs.description: A dubstep song in F minor at 140 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, drop, break, second drop and outro on the four Dubstep patterns. The pad's filter opens over the intro and the snare waits for its last measure to roll into the drop; a beat of silence comes before each drop; the last snare of each phrase of the drops is thrown into the echo, the second drop saturates the wobble harder, and over the outro the snare stays out and the pad fades away.

songs.name: UK Garage
songs.description: A UK garage song in G minor at 132 BPM, all synth sounds, swung hard: intro, main, break, main 2 and outro on the four UK Garage patterns, over Gm9, Gm9, E flat maj7 and F. The organ's filter opens over the intro and it stops for the last beat before the main part; kick and bass drop out for the last two beats before the break; the break's bell hook runs into the echo; in the second main part the rimshot throws into the echo at the end of each phrase, and over the outro the organ fades away.

patterns.name: Breakbeat
patterns.description: Breakbeat, 2 measures: busy syncopated kick, snare on 2 and 4 with 3e, 4& and 4a, 16th hats; open hats every 2 and 3 passes.

patterns.name: Break Roller
patterns.description: Breakbeat, 2 measures: syncopated kick, snare on 2 and 4 with probability ghosts, 16th hats looping every 3 steps against the beat, open hat every 6 steps, flammed snare on 4 of measure 2; 32nd snare roll every 2 passes, descending tom arpeggio every 4, swept high-pass on the hats.

patterns.name: Break Euclid
patterns.description: Breakbeat, 1 measure: euclidean kick (3 pulses over 1, 1a and 2&) then 3&, snare on 2 and 4 with a 64th stutter on 4a every 2 passes, 16th hats gated by probability, rimshot every 5 steps and open hat every 7 across the measure, pitched euclidean toms (5 of 16), 16th clap burst on 2 every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Drum and Bass
patterns.description: Drum and bass two-step, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 3&, snare on 2 and 4 with soft ghosts on 2a and 4a, 8th hats, open hat on 4&; extra kick on 3a every 4 passes, crash every 8.

patterns.name: DnB Wobble Bass
patterns.description: Drum and bass with a wobble bass, 1 measure: F then A flat held bass notes with a short syncopated kick-bass answer, filter wobbled in 8th notes (5.7 Hz at 172 BPM).

patterns.name: Dubstep Intro
patterns.description: The intro and outro of the Dubstep demo, 4 measures in F minor at 140 BPM, all synth sounds: a drifting pad (F minor, D flat, E flat), a bell melody in ping-pong delay, sparse kicks and off-beat hats, and a snare that rolls into the drop over the last measure (the song's automation keeps it for the 8th measure).

patterns.name: Dubstep Drop
patterns.description: The drop of the Dubstep demo, 4 measures in F minor at 140 BPM, half time: kick on 1 with pushes, snare and clap on 3, 8th hats, and a wobble bass written note by note, each 16th with its own filter lock: 8th wobbles on F, quarter-note wobbles on A flat and F, E flat and D flat, a filter that opens on the last C; the 3rd beat of every measure is left to the snare.

patterns.name: Dubstep Break
patterns.description: The break of the Dubstep demo, 4 measures in F minor: the pad and the bell, a long bass with its filter shut, two kicks and hats, and the snare rolling over the last measure into the second drop.

patterns.name: Dubstep Drop 2
patterns.description: The second drop of the Dubstep demo, 4 measures in F minor at 140 BPM: the drop's drums with a crash and a new wobble line with octave stabs whose filter snaps open, quarter wobbles on A flat and E flat, a C and a last F swept open; the pad stays low underneath.

patterns.name: UK Garage Intro
patterns.description: The intro and outro of the UK Garage demo, 4 measures in G minor at 132 BPM, all synth sounds, swung hard: shuffled hats with ghost 16ths, a rimshot in ping-pong delay, a shaker and the organ stabs of Gm9, Gm9, E flat maj7 and F, skipping across the beat.

patterns.name: UK Garage Main
patterns.description: The main part of the UK Garage demo, 4 measures in G minor at 132 BPM: the 2-step kick on 1 and the 16th before 3, a clap on 2 and 4 with shuffled ghost snares, hats, rimshot and shaker, a sub bass on the roots with a skip, ducked by the kick, and the organ stabs.

patterns.name: UK Garage Break
patterns.description: The break of the UK Garage demo, 4 measures in G minor: no kick, a warm pad and a long sub under the chords, a bell hook in ping-pong delay, the organ on the first stab of each measure, hats and shaker.

patterns.name: UK Garage Main 2
patterns.description: The second main part of the UK Garage demo, 4 measures in G minor at 132 BPM: the main part with a crash, open hats on the off-beats, the bass's octave answering at the end of each measure and the bell hook over it.
